description: List the user's scheduled and published posts, newest-scheduled first, 20 per page, with platform, status, scheduled/published time, post URL, tags and engagement metrics. Filter by status (e.g. queued or pending for what is coming up — the content calendar — or published for what went out) or by tag.

status.description: Only posts in this status. Omit for every status except archived and cancelled.

tag_id.description: Only posts carrying this post tag (UUID).

name: list_posts
